text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
What a blunder...
To suffer a breakout on my skin.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: (Has my milky lotion stopped working for me? No, maybe I should reconsider my toner first.)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(Or has the quality of my sleep dropped...?
No, I can't rule out the possibility of an allergy either.)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
......This won't do. I shouldn't burden myself
with even more unnecessary stress like this......

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Either way,
I must deal with this immediately...
